study.question: Does fine-age compact evidence improve the stronger histogram-readout model when both readouts are retained, beyond another readout of already available evidence, and exceed both original frozen source bests?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0018-compact_continuous AUC0.621972692679 exceeds exchangeable_joint by only0.0000949953345 and trails compact_duplicate_histogram0.622165945160 by0.000193252481. Replacing the compact readout input cannot distinguish fine-age redundancy from a tradeoff between histogram access and fine-age access. Preserve the stronger histogram readout and add an independent gated continuous-statistics readout so these information paths need not compete for the same32 hidden coordinates. Conditional complementarity predicts a gain beyond two same-information active controls. This is an unverified local hypothesis; the existing result favors a redundant-access explanation.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local parent retained, then append a separate zero-initialized source-style readout. Parent already exposes histograms through its MLP and its first gated residual; new capacity alone must be controlled.

Prior trial replaces one residual input, whereas this study keeps the histogram residual and adds continuous evidence in parallel. Features and gate are inherited; only simultaneous access is new locally. No general novelty claim.

Inherit four exclusive target-match groups, action-specific counts and freshness moments, moment-derived lower-envelope feature and RMS-normalized context modulation. Keep the exchangeable backbone and histogram path rather than transplanting the older full model.

Entire parent including identity/context/repeat/overlap/exchangeable heads retained. Existing observed histograms and bucketed age embeddings already contain coarse timing evidence; additional heads do not create new raw information.

DIN supplies prior target-aware history aggregation and intensity motivation. Here use inherited hard target-match groups with compact fixed statistics and additive logit heads, with no new per-event learned attention. Supplied baseline-din uses normalized attention despite original DIN relaxing normalization; it is an adapted reference.

Author README verifies category/brand/action histories lack item identities. No item-level branch, unavailable fields, auxiliary matching labels or detailed DMR reproduction claim. Publisher paper unavailable in authorized archive.

study.proposed_difference: Keep first histogram residual active and append a separately parameterized readout of continuous compact statistics. The candidate returns original exchangeable logit + first histogram residual + second continuous residual. Controls replace only the second input by duplicated histogram, histogram-derived coarsened moments or zero. All compute the same alternatives and allocate17196083 total parameters,17078688 embedding and117395 dense (expected; host measurement required). Parent functions are trained jointly from scratch, not frozen weights; no distillation/stacking or label-derived features.
predictions: Primary planned contrast: fusion_continuous full-population validation AUC exceeds fusion_duplicate_histogram AND fusion_coarsened AND fusion_zero, current histogram incumbent, and both frozen original source bests. Single seed is screening, not confirmation.

Paired seeds42/43/44 should retain positive mean AUC differences against both active same-information controls and both sources; report every seed and spread, use paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host authorizes prediction/user-ID access. No significance claim without suitable uncertainty.

The fixed age witness45000/50000 versus55000/60000 seconds keeps parent histogram, log2 ages, event identities and exchangeable support unchanged while continuous features differ; a trained candidate may produce a nonzero second-head difference. This proves representational access only.

Cost likely increases over exchangeable_joint and current incumbent. Match parameter counts across new cells and measure full train/wall/GPU/inference throughput and latency; efficiency is unsupported without a measured favorable frontier.

Inspect frozen history-length, action-composition, category-match, hour and training-frequency slices with supplied sample/positive/negative counts. Existing slices are exploratory; no selective slice win substitutes for primary overall comparison.
falsifiers: If fusion_continuous fails to exceed the retained histogram incumbent or the exchangeable source, conditional complementarity is unsupported for this implementation and recipe.
If duplicated histogram matches or exceeds candidate, added capacity/access is sufficient to explain any gain; if coarsened moments match it, finer timing is not isolated as the cause.
If zero-input arm improves similarly, changes may be due to training nondeterminism or functionally inactive allocation; allocated capacity is not active capacity.
If paired-seed direction reverses or intervals remain compatible with no gain, retain preliminary/null conclusion; one seed does not establish a mechanism.

Broken parent preservation, nonfinite logits/gradients, nonzero empty readout, histogram collision or boundary violations invalidate implementation evidence; account for failed host costs before correction.
If predictive gain costs more training/inference resources without a favorable measured frontier, do not claim efficiency.
alternative_explanations: Same-information direct access or additional active capacity, already favored by round18 redundant control
Seed42 variation and adaptive validation selection; repeated exposures are user-clustered
Different feature geometry/conditioning and optimizer trajectories, even at equal parameter count
Finite training horizon and interference through jointly trained shared embeddings; retained architecture is not a fixed function after training
Continuous moments may be redundant, too weak, or poorly accessed; a null result does not refute every continuous-time mechanism
Float32 cancellation in lower envelopes, recorded order/padding discrepancies up to5.33e-5; these are deterministic features, not certified extrema
The raw data and causal construction are host owned; no fresh raw schema audit is possible here. Undated static snapshots limit production point-in-time claims.

observations.provenance: Only allowed own-arm committed validation receipts and authorized archived sources; protocol/runtime resolved on entry. No new training, raw-data inspection, test feedback, packages or other agents.
observations.interpretation: All supplied trials succeeded; no runtime failure is currently pending. Round18 continuous branch has finer-age access according to candidate-supplied witness, yet loses to duplicated histogram; this is a mechanistic negative despite a small gain over exchangeable_joint. Coarsened and zero branches trail exchangeable in AUC. Do not erase these outcomes or equate diagnostic access with predictive utility. No prior unexposed trajectories are inferred.
observations.provisional_revision: Replace the provisional unconditional compact-evidence advantage explanation with unsupported complementarity and a competing redundant-access explanation. The remaining test is conditional simultaneous access; a null must remain a null, not evidence for a broad impossibility.
observations.knowledge_storage: No separate memory file is writable in propose phase. Preserve this prospective observation/revision in proposal and append host trial receipts with actual outcomes and failures; never copy future withheld outcomes into open memory.
observations.additional_confound: Extra initialized modules consume RNG after the exact parent prefix; if host stochastic data ordering shares that RNG, the zero arm may alter the training trajectory. All new modes consume the same RNG. The inactive arm is a functional/trajectory control, not an active-capacity match.
